times.phrase: plugged in more than {d} days ago

list_child.name: list_network_sessions
list_child.desc: This tool retrieves every charging session recorded in the network's session log. It returns the full list across every station and fleet.

decoys.name: list_roaming_sessions
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves every charging session recorded in the roaming partner feed. It returns the full list across every partner network and fleet.

decoys.name: list_reservation_sessions
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves every charging session booked in the stall reservation calendar. It returns the full list across every station and fleet.

decoys.name: list_depot_sessions
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves every charging session logged by the private depot chargers. It returns the full list across every depot and fleet.

get_child.name: get_session_cdr
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the charge detail record of a single charging session using its unique identifier. It returns the session's state, timing, and fleet.

decoys.name: get_session_meter
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the meter readings of a single charging session using its unique identifier. It returns the energy reading logged each minute.

decoys.name: get_session_receipt
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the billing receipt of a single charging session using its unique identifier. It returns the tariff, fees, and total charged.

decoys.name: get_session_diagnostics
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the charger diagnostics of a single charging session using its unique identifier. It returns the error codes and voltage traces.

list_parent.name: list_portal_fleets
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every fleet with an account in the operator portal. It includes each fleet's name and contact email on file.

decoys.name: list_tariff_fleets
decoys.desc: This tool lists every fleet enrolled in the overnight off-peak tariff plan. It includes each fleet's rate tier and billing email.

decoys.name: list_rfid_fleets
decoys.desc: This tool lists every fleet in the RFID card issuance queue. It includes each fleet's card count and shipping address.

decoys.name: list_prospect_fleets
decoys.desc: This tool lists every fleet in the sales pipeline for a network contract. It includes each fleet's size and account manager.

get_parent.name: get_fleet_portal
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches the portal account of a single fleet using its unique identifier. It returns the fleet's name and contact email.

decoys.name: get_fleet_tariff
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the tariff plan of a single fleet using its unique identifier. It returns the per-kilowatt-hour rates and idle fees.

decoys.name: get_fleet_cards
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the RFID card list of a single fleet using its unique identifier. It returns each card number and its vehicle.

decoys.name: get_fleet_vehicles
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the vehicle roster of a single fleet using its unique identifier. It returns each vehicle's model and battery size.

delete_child.name: purge_session_cdr
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes the charge detail record of a charging session. The deletion is final once it is executed.

decoys.name: purge_session_meter
decoys.desc: This tool permanently erases the meter readings of a charging session from the network. The erasure is final once it is executed.

decoys.name: void_session_charges
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the billing charges on a charging session in the network. The void is final once it is executed.

decoys.name: purge_session_diagnostics
decoys.desc: This tool permanently erases the charger diagnostics of a charging session. The erasure is final once it is executed.

set_enum.name: set_session_state
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a charging session's state among queued, charging, completed, and faulted. It is used to correct or advance the session's recorded lifecycle.

decoys.name: forecast_session_state
decoys.desc: This tool sets the state a charging session is projected to reach by the next load window, among queued, charging, completed, and faulted. It is used for grid planning.

decoys.name: request_session_state
decoys.desc: This tool submits a request to move a charging session among queued, charging, completed, and faulted. It is used by site hosts reporting a change for approval.

decoys.name: alert_session_state
decoys.desc: This tool sets an alert that fires when a charging session reaches queued, charging, completed, or faulted. It is used to watch a session from the operations center.

set_bool.name: flag_fault
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a charging session as faulted due to a hardware or connectivity problem. It is typically used after a station reports an error code.

decoys.name: flag_dcfc
decoys.desc: This tool flags a charging session as DC fast charging due to the connector used. It is typically used after a station reports a CCS or CHAdeMO plug-in.

decoys.name: flag_idle
decoys.desc: This tool flags a charging session for idle fees due to a vehicle staying plugged in after charging. It is typically used after a station reports an overstay.

decoys.name: flag_dispute
decoys.desc: This tool flags a charging session as disputed due to a billing complaint from the driver. It is typically used after a fleet contests a charge.

set_ref.name: transfer_fleet
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a charging session to a different fleet account, for example when a vehicle was matched to the wrong account. The session's history and energy totals stay attached to the record.

decoys.name: sponsor_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool charges the cost of a charging session to a sponsoring fleet account, for example when an employer pays for a driver's charge. The charge then appears on that fleet's invoice.

decoys.name: credit_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool credits the energy from a charging session to a different fleet's carbon credit ledger, for example when a partner claims the offsets. The credits then appear on its statement.

decoys.name: share_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool shares the receipt of a charging session with a different fleet account, for example when a leased vehicle's owner needs the record. That fleet then sees it in its portal.

send.name: email_fleet
send.desc: This tool sends an email notification to the fleet account associated with a session. It is used to tell fleets about session status or account issues.

decoys.name: sms_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool sends an SMS alert to the fleet account associated with a session. It is used to reach fleet dispatchers about a stalled or faulted charge.

decoys.name: invoice_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool sends a billing invoice to the fleet account associated with a session. It is used to collect payment for energy delivered and idle fees.

decoys.name: webhook_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool posts a webhook event to the fleet account associated with a session. It is used to update the fleet's own telematics system in real time.
child_verbs: post a webhook to the fleet behind {obj}
push an event to the fleet behind {obj}

create.name: open_session
create.desc: This tool opens a new charging session for a fleet, with an optional starting state. It is used when a vehicle plugs in at a station.

decoys.name: book_stall
decoys.desc: This tool books a new stall reservation for a fleet, with an optional starting state. It is used when a driver holds a charger ahead of arrival.

decoys.name: schedule_window
decoys.desc: This tool schedules a new smart charging window for a fleet, with an optional starting state. It is used when a depot shifts load to off-peak hours.

decoys.name: open_test
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new test charge for a fleet, with an optional starting state. It is used when a technician verifies a charger after a repair.

list_notes.name: list_session_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single charging session. It includes every remark operators and support staff have logged against it.

decoys.name: list_session_errors
decoys.desc: This tool returns the error events attached to a single charging session. It includes every fault code the charger has logged against it.

decoys.name: list_session_tickets
decoys.desc: This tool returns the support tickets attached to a single charging session. It includes every complaint drivers have raised against it.

decoys.name: list_session_audits
decoys.desc: This tool returns the audit entries attached to a single charging session. It includes every billing adjustment staff have logged against it.

add_note.name: add_session_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a charging session, with an optional title. It is used to record operator remarks about the charge.

decoys.name: add_session_ticket
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new support ticket on a charging session, with an optional title. It is used to record a driver complaint about the charge.

decoys.name: add_session_error
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new error event on a charging session, with an optional title. It is used to record a fault a technician saw on site.

decoys.name: add_session_audit
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new audit entry on a charging session, with an optional title. It is used to record a billing adjustment to the charge.

update_note.name: edit_session_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text of an existing note on a charging session, with an optional new title. It is used to correct or expand a remark after logging.

decoys.name: reply_session_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply beneath an existing note on a charging session, with an optional title. It is used when support answers an operator's question.

decoys.name: resolve_session_note
decoys.desc: This tool resolves an existing note on a charging session with closing text and an optional title. It is used once the issue in the remark is fixed.

decoys.name: escalate_session_note
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing note on a charging session to field service with added text and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs a site visit.

delete_note.name: delete_session_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a charging session. The note is erased from the network log for good.

decoys.name: delete_note_thread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a note and its replies from a charging session. The thread is erased from the network log for good.

decoys.name: redact_session_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on a charging session. The text is blacked out in the network log for good.

decoys.name: retract_session_ticket
decoys.desc: This tool permanently retracts a support ticket filed on a charging session. The ticket is withdrawn from the queue for good.

set_image.name: set_session_photo
set_image.desc: This tool sets the photo shown on a charging session record. It is typically a shot of the vehicle at the stall taken by the driver.

decoys.name: set_session_screen
decoys.desc: This tool sets the charger screen photo on a charging session record. It is typically a shot of the display showing the final reading.

decoys.name: set_session_damage
decoys.desc: This tool sets the damage photo on a charging session record. It is typically a close-up of a broken cable or connector at the stall.

decoys.name: set_session_plate
decoys.desc: This tool sets the license plate photo on a charging session record. It is typically the capture from the parking camera at the stall.

writer.name: compose_text
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the charging sessions it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_statement
decoys.desc: This tool writes a monthly energy statement from a brief, which states the period in the account manager's own words, and the charging sessions it covers. It returns the finished statement.

decoys.name: compose_incident
decoys.desc: This tool writes an outage incident report from a brief, which states the cause in the technician's own words, and the charging sessions affected. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: compose_esg
decoys.desc: This tool writes a sustainability summary from a brief, which states the goals in the fleet's own words, and the charging sessions it should count. It returns the finished summary.

image.name: generate_picture
image.desc: This tool generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_sitemap
decoys.desc: This tool generates a station site map from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the map.

decoys.name: generate_signage
decoys.desc: This tool generates stall signage artwork from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the sign.

decoys.name: generate_chart
decoys.desc: This tool generates a load curve chart from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the chart.

search.name: search_support
search.desc: This tool searches the network operator's support articles with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the platform works.

decoys.name: search_ocpp
decoys.desc: This tool searches the OCPP protocol specification with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a charger message format.

decoys.name: search_manuals
decoys.desc: This tool searches the charger hardware manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what a fault code means.

decoys.name: search_tariffs
decoys.desc: This tool searches the utility tariff filings with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up demand charges for a site.
